body_revisions.scope: Run a real engine with and without n-gram proposals under fixed greedy outputs.
body_revisions.observation: The eight native runs agree on the emitted sequence. Full, partial and missing proposals use 2, 3, 5 and 6 batches; the early rejection rolls back to 13 retained positions and next consumes the correction at position 13.
